fusions.name: Ricochet Bite
fusions.desc: Sends a bite at the first enemy it meets, dealing 5 damage. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Apex Drop
fusions.desc: Your landing deals 14 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocks them back 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises +8% per 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max +40%).

fusions.name: Boundless Leap
fusions.desc: A short burst of movement that carries you 6 tiles forward. Using it increases your movement speed by 25% for 3s.

fusions.name: Blood Between Bounds
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you heal for 20% of all damage you deal for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
